description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EntityOperation' for entity-related operations in the OFBiz mini-language framework. It manages the extraction of delegator names from XML configuration and provides access to the relevant Delegator object within a method context.

classes.name: EntityOperation
classes.description: Abstract base class for entity operations, handling the retrieval of a Delegator depending on the configuration and context.

methods.name: EntityOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity operation, extracting the delegator name attribute from an XML element and preparing the flexible string expander.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance, either by name from the environment map or the default from the method context.
